name: explain
description: Explain a concept, codebase, paper, or system to one specific reader, sequenced on what that reader already holds

interface.shortDescription: Explain something to the reader in front of you, not to a generic beginner
interface.longDescription: Fixes the reader model first — what they already hold about this target, what they expected instead, the level they asked at, and the wrong model they may be running — then explains the difference. Scaffolding that helps a novice costs an expert, so the same target is explained two different ways rather than at two different lengths.
